install.packages("readxl")

library(readxl)


df <- read_excel("private_dataP.xlsx")

df
```{r}

```

normal_vote <- df[df$evote == 0, ] 
e_vote <- df[df$evote == 1, ]

```{r}

```

normal_table <- table(normal_vote$party)
e_table <- table(e_vote$party)

e_table
normal_table

```{r}

```
#A
contingency_tableA <- table(df$party, df$evote)
chisq.test(contingency_tableA)
#p-value = 0.07145


#C
#sex
contingency_tableS <- table(df$evote, df$sex)
chisq.test(contingency_tableS)
#p-value = 0.9988

#zip
contingency_tableZ <- table(df$evote, df$zip)
chisq.test(contingency_tableZ)
#p-value = 0.6796

#age
install.packages("lubridate")
library(lubridate)
df$age <- floor(time_length(interval(as.Date(df$dob), Sys.Date()), "years"))
contingency_tableA <- table(df$evote, df$age)
chisq.test(contingency_tableA)
#p-value = 0.1689

#citizenship
contingency_tableCi <- table(df$evote, df$citizenship)
chisq.test(contingency_tableCi)
#p-value = 0.2399

#marital status
contingency_tableM <- table(df$evote, df$marital_status)
chisq.test(contingency_tableM)
#p-value = 0.1541
